rule: A gap is never closed by reclassification. Status changes only with executable evidence.

closedThisWave.finding: Installed app could not boot: lock validity decided by PID liveness alone, so a live-but-idle orchestrator produced NO_GO/PROCESS_LOCKED while ports were free.
convergence/stop.cjs resolved app root from caller cwd, released the wrong lock, did not verify exit, and discovery matched only the dev folder name.
pnpm build covers ./packages/** only and packaging uses esbuild, so apps/** were never typechecked; 75 errors had accumulated in apps/control-plane-api.
closedThisWave.evidence: final-completion/app-typecheck-gate.json (0 errors across 3 apps), registered in test:release

closedThisWave.finding: reconcileInterruptedJob returned `reconciled` only on the no-op branch, so boot recovery counted zero for jobs it actually reconciled.
closedThisWave.evidence: explicit return contract + app typecheck gate; pnpm test:release PASS

closedThisWave.finding: A persisted session file lacking `recent` would throw on session.recent.entities; the shape was untyped so the risk was invisible.
closedThisWave.evidence: OsSession type + normalizeRecent on merge; app typecheck gate

closedThisWave.finding: view-adapter dropped the lineage chain tip from the API contract.
/healthz reported flat ok:true while startup readiness reported DEGRADED.
closedThisWave.evidence: describeServiceHealth() shared by /healthz and /readyz; alpha-final-gate degradedModeHonest PASS

closedThisWave.finding: esbuild stripped renderer provenance so the professional UX contract could not be verified in the packaged shell.
loadHome().catch(function(){}) silently discarded a Home reload failure.
@scios/product-kernel and the professional domain registry resolved to implicit any inside the app, so the Product Kernel authority boundary had no type checking.
closedThisWave.evidence: generated declarations + drift check in app-typecheck-gate; surfaced and fixed a duplicate-label defect in /v1/intent/compile

closedThisWave.finding: The pg driver probe reported ABSENT under package tests and PRESENT under the app. Measured cause: the tsx dev loader resolves into pnpm's store (node_modules/.pnpm/pg@8.23.0), which plain Node does not; the packaged runtime reports ABSENT. The probe now anchors to the module realpath and reports its resolution basis, and driver presence is treated as an observation rather than an invariant.
closedThisWave.evidence: Packaged runtime GET /v1/ecl/engine/infra pgDriver=ABSENT; dev loader PRESENT with resolvedFrom recorded; smoke assertion strengthened to verify presence never promotes livePostgres/optionalInfra/ready/pool.connected
closedThisWave.note: Fixed by making the probe explainable and asserting the real invariant, not by removing the check.

closedThisWave.finding: apps/control-plane-api smoke:ecl-dil was referenced by no gate, so its failing assertion was invisible.
